basic_steps: Step in sequence with the pulse of the khaijadi drum while maintaining group formation.
Join the collective vocal refrain of the bhajan while stepping to the rhythm.
Incorporate theatrical hand gestures representing the roles or implements of the deity being narrated.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on matching basic footwork to the drumbeat and contributing to the choral singing before taking on specific theatrical roles.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic, driven by the steady beat of the khaijadi drum
